name: Diraden
description: A plane dominated by black mana and endless night, ruled by an immortal prince.

description_citations.text: "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Gideon escape captivity on Diraden through a plan that ends in the death of Prince Velrav and the end of the plane's eternal night.
timeline.quote: she concocted a plan of escape with Gideon that culminated in the death of Velrav

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Diraden Gideon and Chandra are captured by the Fog Riders after Falia's plot; Gideon kills one Fog Rider.
timeline.quote: Gideon showed up at an opportune moment and slew one of the Fog Riders

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra beheads Prince Velrav during his ritual, ending Diraden's Eternal Night.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon follows Chandra to Diraden, where the prince's shroud of night prevents planeswalking, and Jurl attacks but is subdued.

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Falia, smitten with Gideon, sends him hunting and summons Fog Riders to abduct Chandra; Gideon kills one Fog Rider before both are captured.
timeline.quote: slays one of the Fog Riders before both he and Chandra are incapacitated and abducted

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Velrav of planeswalkers to win Gideon better treatment, and Velrav decides to harness Gideon's essence.
timeline.quote: Velrav now believes he can harness Gideon's essence to become a planeswalker himself

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra beheads Prince Velrav with a sword of fire and King Gelidor impales himself on it, lifting the spell preventing planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Chandra creates a sword of fire and beheads the prince.

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
